name: Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the pharmaceutical business in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through five segments: Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices and Medical Diagnosis, Medical Services, Medical Distribution and Retail, and Others. The company is involved in the pharmaceutical manufacturing in the therapeutic areas of solid oncology, including tumors and hematologic malignancies, as well as immune-inflammatory disorders, metabolism and digestive systems, anti-infection, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and APIs and intermediates.
